# KRCW: the West Coast after the civil war (generated by build/am_p22_reunification.py)
# monthly, in USA or WCA scope (on_monthly_*)
krcw_reun_monthly = {
	# the civil war is won and Sacramento still stands: the West Coast question opens
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = KRCW_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_started }
			OR = {
				AND = { tag = WCA NOT = { country_exists = USA } }
				AND = { tag = USA NOT = { country_exists = WCA } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = PSA
				NOT = { has_war_with = PSA }
				PSA = { OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } }
			}
			krcw_reun_begin = yes
		}
		# Sacramento fell during the civil war itself: the winner inherits the West Coast
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { country_exists = PSA }
				any_owned_state = { is_core_of = PSA }
			}
			krcw_reun_finish_absorbed = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = krcw_reun_winner
			NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_done }
		}
		# Sacramento went under in some other war and we hold its states
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { country_exists = PSA }
				any_owned_state = { is_core_of = PSA }
			}
			krcw_reun_finish_absorbed = yes
		}
		# the war in the Rockies drags on: the Reno talks
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
				has_war_with = PSA
				NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_reun_talks_offered }
				PSA = { has_capitulated = no }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = { flag = krcw_reun_war_since days > 300 }
					surrender_progress > 0.3
					PSA = { surrender_progress > 0.5 }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = krcw_reun_talks_offered
			country_event = { id = krcw_reun.23 days = 5 }
		}
		# the war ended some other way (a peace conference)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
				NOT = { has_war_with = PSA }
				country_exists = PSA
			}
			clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
			if = {
				limit = { PSA = { is_subject_of = ROOT } }
				krcw_reun_compact = yes
			}
			else = { krcw_reun_cold_peace = yes }
		}
		# Sacramento slipped out of the compact (freed in some peace)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = KRCW_reun_compact
				country_exists = PSA
				PSA = { is_subject = no }
			}
			clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_compact
			krcw_reun_cold_peace = yes
		}
	}
}
# winner scope: open the question
krcw_reun_begin = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_started
	set_country_flag = krcw_reun_winner
	if = { limit = { tag = WCA } set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_wca }
	else = { set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_usa }
	# the Sacramento question is now an American one: the bloc courting stops
	set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned
	PSA = {
		every_owned_state = { set_state_flag = krcw_west_coast_state }
		if = {
			limit = { is_subject = no }
			country_event = { id = krcw_reun.2 days = 3 }
		}
	}
	country_event = { id = krcw_reun.1 days = 20 }
}
# winner scope: Sacramento is gone and its states are ours
krcw_reun_finish_absorbed = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_started
	set_country_flag = krcw_reun_winner
	if = { limit = { tag = WCA } clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_usa set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_wca }
	else = { clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_wca set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_by_usa }
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = PSA }
		set_state_flag = krcw_west_coast_state
	}
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_how_talks
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_how_forced
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_how_war
	krcw_reun_after_union = yes
}
# winner scope, after Sacramento's states have come over
krcw_reun_after_union = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_done
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_compact
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_cold
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_ultimatum
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_deferred
	if = { limit = { has_idea = krcw_reun_unfinished_union } remove_ideas = krcw_reun_unfinished_union }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = krcw_reun_federal_compact } remove_ideas = krcw_reun_federal_compact }
	add_ideas = krcw_reun_west_integrating
	add_stability = 0.03
	krcw_tension_up_small = yes
	country_event = { id = krcw_reun.40 days = 20 }
	news_event = { id = krcw_reun.50 days = 2 }
}
# winner scope: Sacramento joins (the caller sets KRCW_reun_how_*)
krcw_reun_annex_west = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PSA }
		PSA = { every_owned_state = { set_state_flag = krcw_west_coast_state } }
		annex_country = { target = PSA transfer_troops = yes }
	}
	krcw_reun_after_union = yes
}
# winner scope: the federal compact (Sacramento keeps its Congress, we take diplomacy and the fleet)
krcw_reun_compact = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_compact
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_cold
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_ultimatum
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_deferred
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_compact_since
	set_country_flag = krcw_reun_compact_since
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PSA PSA = { NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } }
		if = { limit = { PSA = { is_in_faction = yes } } PSA = { leave_faction = yes } }
		puppet = PSA
	}
	if = { limit = { has_idea = krcw_reun_unfinished_union } remove_ideas = krcw_reun_unfinished_union }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = krcw_reun_federal_compact } } add_ideas = krcw_reun_federal_compact }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PSA }
		PSA = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = krcw_reun_psa_alone } remove_ideas = krcw_reun_psa_alone }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = krcw_reun_federal_compact } } add_ideas = krcw_reun_federal_compact }
			clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_psa_cold_since
		}
	}
	krcw_detente_up_small = yes
	news_event = { id = krcw_reun.51 days = 2 }
}
# winner scope: nothing agreed, nobody marches
krcw_reun_cold_peace = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_cold
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_ultimatum
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_protected
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_protector_fra
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_protector_sov
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_deferred
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_cold_since
	set_country_flag = krcw_reun_cold_since
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_idea = krcw_reun_unfinished_union } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = krcw_reun_unfinished_union days = 540 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PSA }
		PSA = {
			clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_overture
			clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_psa_cold_since
			set_country_flag = krcw_reun_psa_cold_since
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = krcw_reun_psa_alone } } add_ideas = krcw_reun_psa_alone }
		}
	}
}
# winner scope: the war in the Rockies. A winner sharing Sacramento's bloc must leave it first; if Sacramento's
# bloc leader then defends it, faction_calls.py brings that bloc in (and the world war, if we sit in the other bloc).
krcw_reun_war_west = {
	set_global_flag = KRCW_reun_war
	clr_global_flag = KRCW_reun_cold
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_talks_offered
	clr_country_flag = krcw_reun_war_since
	set_country_flag = krcw_reun_war_since
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PSA PSA = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
			PSA = { leave_faction = yes }
		}
		else = { leave_faction = yes }
	}
	declare_war_on = { target = PSA type = annex_everything }
	add_war_support = 0.05
	krcw_tension_up_medium = yes
	news_event = { id = krcw_reun.52 days = 1 }
}
